thanks for your patience!

 

 

 

From: cloud9baud@gmail.com <cloud9baud@gmail.com>

To: danish.sayyed@narwal.ai
Cc: 'Jishnu Nath' <jish.nath@cloudbaud.com>
Subject: Rate confirmation

 

I confirm.
resume coming soon

-Jish Nath

 



Hello Jishnu,

 

It was nice speaking with you! Please acknowledge the below.

 

I “Jishnu Nath” hereby confirm my interest and authorize to represent my candidature for the position of Senior Technical Solutions Lead, for a Remote role with Narwal (Client - Trimedx). I confirm that the information provided in my resume is accurate to the best of my knowledge.

 

Also, confirming the rate i.e., $110/hr. C2C.

 

Job Title: Senior Technical Solutions Lead

Location: Remote

Type: Contract

 

Role Title:

We are looking for a strong Senior Technical Solutions Lead who can operate as a hands-on solution expert across business, technology, and delivery. This person should have architect-level technical depth but should not be someone who only stays at the design or presentation level. They need to be practical, hands-on, comfortable coding when needed, and capable of seeing solutions through from concept to delivery.

 

Key expectations:

  • Strong technical solutioning background
  • Architect-level understanding of modern application and data solutions.
  • Strong experience across web applications, data platforms, APIs, integrations, cloud, and enterprise systems.
  • Able to evaluate business problems and design practical, scalable technical solutions.

 

Hands-on engineering ability

  • Must be comfortable coding, prototyping, reviewing code, and helping engineering teams solve technical problems.
  • Should not be a pure high-level architect.
  • Needs to be credible with developers as well as business stakeholders.

 

AI-enabled productivity mindset

  • Strong ability to use AI tools to accelerate development, analysis, documentation, solutioning, prototyping, testing, and delivery.
  • Comfortable using code-assist tools and modern AI productivity tools as part of daily work.
  • Should know how to leverage AI to move faster and improve quality, not just talk about AI conceptually.

 

End-to-end solution ownership

  • Able to take a business problem from discovery to solution design, estimation, build, delivery, and production readiness.
  • Can connect business needs, technical architecture, engineering execution, and final outcomes.
  • Helps ensure projects are not just designed, but actually delivered successfully.

 

Strong business and client-facing skills

  • Comfortable working directly with business stakeholders, technology leaders, and delivery teams.
  • Can explain technical concepts in simple, business-friendly language.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, and executive communication skills.

 

Thought leadership and advisory mindset

  • Brings ideas, recommendations, and best practices.
  • Can guide the client and internal teams on better ways to solve problems.
  • Able to challenge constructively and provide practical direction.

 

Delivery leadership support

  • Can support the manager/client leader in making sure projects move in the right direction.
  • Able to identify risks, unblock issues, guide teams, and ensure strong delivery quality.

 

 

 

 

Danish Sayyed 

Associate Manager - Talent Acquisition

danish.sayyed@narwal.ai

+1 513 757 8605

www.narwal.ai
